idea_description: A cash-flow and expense management platform for small businesses. It reads bank and UPI statements with consent, sorts every expense into categories, and shows the owner how much cash is left and which bills fall due next. Owners who track this in spreadsheets today get a weekly forecast instead.
target_customers: Small business owners in Indian cities
relevant_details: Pilot planned with twelve shops in Pune. We know Khatabook is used widely for ledgers.
